thread:
maria_cs: Koru Labs pilot starts Mon. Thought it would help to run a 2-week enablement sprint to get their product + our infra validated. Who's available for a 30m kickoff today? High-level agenda: owners, success metrics, timelines, training, E2E test plan.

oliver_sales: I can do 3pm PT. Main stakeholders: Koru PM = @june_k (they prefer async notes). Renewal risk: they mentioned SLAs for latency — want to capture a baseline and an acceptable regression window.

deepa_se: 3pm PT works. I'll bring the test plan and recommended batch/quantization config. Proposed success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 512 tokens, two end-to-end user flows validated, and no PII persisted in logs.

sam_success: Love the criteria. I'll own enablement docs and run two short training sessions (30m) next Tue/Wed. Can we add an adoption metric: >= 70% of pilot users completing the demo flows at least once?

alan_pm: Add: feature-flagged canary rollout + rollback plan. Proposed timeline: kickoff today -> bench + smoke tests by Wed -> training Tue/Wed -> pilot review end of week 2. OK?

ben_ops: I'll draft the runbook and on-call rotation for the pilot. Need the Koru infra ops contact and expected maintenance windows — @june_k can you confirm?

june_k: (Koru) Thanks — 3pm PT works. I'll share credentials and a small CSV of sample inputs before the meeting. SLA note: latency target is soft during pilot, but we want to spot regressions vs baseline. Happy to provide their ops contact.

maria_cs: Perfect. Agenda for 3pm: 1) intros/roles 2) success criteria & metrics 3) test plan owners 4) training schedule 5) rollout & rollback 6) feedback loop. I'll post a MURAL + doc after this thread. @deploy-bot please create a kickoff doc and template tasks.

deploy-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.docs/koru-pilot-1766123456 — folder: /customers/koru/pilot. Assignments template added.

deepa_se: Quick config snippet I'll share in the meeting:
```
model: redwood-3b
batch_size: auto
quant: int8
latency_target_ms: 300
```

sam_success: I'll prepare a short user feedback form (3 quick qs) and drop the link into the kickoff doc. Also suggest weekly check-ins every Fri 11am PT for pilot health and adoption.

maria_cs: Great. See you at 3pm PT. If anyone can't make, leave comments in the doc and tag me. :thumbsup:
